title: The Villas #C201 | KEY.co
description_expanded: The Villas at Santa Rosa Beach C201 offers an exceptional Gulf-front escape in an exclusive gated community along 30A. This stunning three-bedroom, three-bath condo blends coastal elegance with luxurious comfort, accommodating up to eight guests. The open-concept living and dining area is adorned with fresh, modern furnishings and serene hues inspired by the sand and sea, creating a peaceful retreat. A newly upgraded kitchen with stainless steel appliances makes meal prep a breeze, while the breakfast bar and dining table invite casual gatherings. Relax in the living room, equipped with a 60” HD flat-screen TV and Blu-Ray player, or step onto the private balcony to enjoy sweeping views of the Gulf—perfect for soaking in breathtaking sunsets. Ideal for unwinding after a day of adventure, the master suite features a king-sized bed, en suite bath with a jetted tub, and a spacious dressing area. The second suite also offers a king-sized bed, while the third suite has two queen beds, all equipped with new flat-screen TVs for added comfort. Located just steps from Gulf Place, where galleries, shops, and restaurants abound, this villa is the perfect base for exploring the best of 30A. Take a leisurely bike ride along the scenic 19-mile Timpoochee Trail or enjoy the pristine beach just outside your door. At The Villas at Santa Rosa Beach C201, every moment invites relaxation and coastal charm.
